Seven-figure e-commerce seller Travis Marziani shows beginners how to build a fully functional online store in under 10 minutes using Hostinger Horizons, Hostinger’s new AI website builder, with a complete step-by-step walkthrough and real product examples.

- Travis Marziani demonstrates Hostinger Horizons, Hostinger’s AI website builder, to create a complete e-commerce website from scratch for his Clove Water brand

- How Travis writes effective AI prompts to generate a clean, minimalist online store layout, images, copy, and product pages

- Connecting payment platforms in the backend to accept orders on your new e-commerce website
- Publishing the site, choosing a domain name, and reviewing the final live e-commerce store with Travis Marziani
- Five advanced secrets to high-converting AI prompts: defining a customer avatar, using Cody the AI prompt agent, providing structure (hero section, service columns, contact form), pasting raw notes, and using image references for layout
- Using screenshots and image uploads as references so AI can build specific sections like recipe/how-to-prepare layouts and custom page designs

Travis Marziani shows beginners exactly how to launch a professional online store using AI, showcasing Hostinger Horizons’ no-code workflow, drag-and-drop editing, AI-generated product pages, fast website creation, simple integrations, and beginner-friendly web design for anyone wanting AI-powered e-commerce tools and step-by-step online store tutorials.
